title: Development Application → Decision
subtitle: Demo 1 · URA · CORENET X + DC Assistant

inputs.label: Development Application
inputs.description: A registration pack, a fee receipt, a lodged file set and a coordinated model arrive across separate systems — and on a resubmission, every one of them is re-read by hand.
inputs.inputFormat: Registration pack and area schedule, fee invoice and receipt, lodged file set, federated model, and the QP's written response to prior issues.

persona.quote: Every case starts with me rebuilding its history out of several systems and somebody's inbox — before I can even begin evaluating it.

inputs.label: Recommendation for Approval
inputs.description: The processing officer's recommendation arrives with its findings, overrides and consultation replies spread across the same records the officer has already worked through.
inputs.inputFormat: The recommendation and formal issues, machine findings with their overrides and stated reasons, consultation replies, and prior decisions.

persona.quote: I re-check the evidence and the model detail the officer already reviewed, because nothing shows me what their conclusion actually rests on.

stations.label: SUBMISSION & CASE SETUP
stations.description: Registers the application, routes the case, and checks the payment against the fee guideline.

agents.name: A1 Registration and Fee Verification
agents.description: Reads the registration pack and the payment record, works out what was due from the fee guideline, and reports any shortfall.
agents.output: Fee checked: amount due, amount paid, and the provision applied.

stations.label: PRE-VALIDATION
stations.description: Reads the automated model check output against what this submission was required to contain. The checks themselves are left untouched.

agents.name: A2 Submission Completeness and Geo-Reference Validation
agents.description: Works out what this submission was required to contain, matches the lodged files against it, and confirms the model is geo-referenced to the registered site.
agents.output: One completeness verdict, plus a diagnosis of any geo-reference failure.

stations.label: EVALUATION
stations.description: Compares what changed, routes the referrals, retrieves the site's history, and consolidates every comment into formal issues.

agents.name: A3 Submission Delta & Special Control Review
agents.description: Compares this submission against the previously submitted or approved version and reports what changed against each prior issue. Also checks against any special site controls or TCOT conditions imposed.
agents.output: Every prior issue marked: addressed, persisting, or never answered. Also populates a list containing special site controls to be noted of -- with potential non-compliant issues.

agents.name: A4 Referral Consultations
agents.description: Proposes which internal teams and which external agencies should see this case, and for which issue, against URA's routing guidance for the site.
agents.output: A referral list you send — with what it ruled out, and why.

agents.name: A5 Site Precedent Retrieval
agents.description: Retrieves approved uses, enforcement history and previous decisions for the site from the case and document records, then answers follow-up questions about them.
agents.output: Comparable decisions with their grounds, conditions, and source references.

agents.name: A6 Issue Consolidation
agents.description: Groups related findings from the rule checks, internal teams, external agencies and email, removes the duplicates, and drafts the consolidated issues for the case record.
agents.output: Clustered issues drafted for your edit — conflicts named, never resolved.

stations.label: AO APPROVAL
stations.description: Assembles the case for the Approving Officer and checks that every finding and override traces to a real source.

agents.name: A7 AO Briefing Pack
agents.description: Assembles one cited document that orients the Approving Officer — what is proposed, what the site carries, what was found, who was consulted, and what the officer recommends.
agents.output: A sectioned pack, every line linked — with counts showing what it left out.

agents.name: A8 Evidence and Override Assurance
agents.description: Takes every point where an officer overrode a machine finding, and checks whether the reason given cites evidence that can actually be found.
agents.output: Citation coverage: what traces to a real source — completeness, never merits.

outputs.label: Intake Checks Reconciled
outputs.description: Registration, payment, files and geo-reference arrive as one verdict instead of separate records in separate systems.

outputs.label: Coordination On the Record
outputs.description: Referrals, site history and agency comments live in the case record rather than an inbox.

outputs.label: Decision Traceability
outputs.description: Every finding and override traces to a real source, and the outcome stays the officer's decision.

steps.caption: A URA processing officer rebuilds each case from several systems — registration, payment, files, and the model — before evaluation can even start.
Downstream, the approving officer re-checks the same evidence, because nothing shows what the recommendation rests on.
A development application arrives — registration pack, fee receipt, lodged files, and a coordinated model.
The Registration and Fee Verification Agent reads the registration and payment records and reports the shortfall against the guideline.
The Submission Completeness Agent derives what was required, matches the lodged files, and diagnoses the geo-reference failure.
Delta Review, Referral, Site Precedent and Issue Consolidation Agents evaluate the case and draft the formal issues.
The AO Briefing Pack Agent assembles the cited case; the Evidence and Override Assurance Agent checks every override traces to a source.
Registration, payment, files and geo-reference reconciled into a single verdict — every line opening its own source.
Referrals, site history and agency comments captured in the record — drafted for the officer to send.
Every finding and override traces to a real source — and selecting the outcome stays the officer's decision.
